Notes
Shape Preview — Color-Coded Edges Update Live
Mode: In Preset Shape, drag any edge of the drawing to stretch it — type to set the exact length while dragging. Switch to Custom Draw for irregular shapes: click and drag toward the next point (snaps to 45°), type to set the exact length while dragging, release to place it. Click near the start to close the shape, drag any corner once closed.
Tool: Draw Wall: click and drag to draw a wall — type to set the exact length while dragging (same mechanism as Custom Draw), release to place it; click near an existing wall's end to start the next one from there. Cabinet Run/appliances: pick a tool, click a wall (or a placed cabinet run, for appliances) to snap one into place. Place Countertop: click a cabinet run to lay the shape built in Preset Shape/Custom Draw on top of it.
Place:
Pick a type, click the spot · drag any marker to fine-tune
Sink shape:
— natural stone integrated sinks run $1,200-$2,000+ over a standard cutout depending on bowl count; carved from the same slab, bonded with no mounting clips, requires 3/8" min. wall thickness
⚠️ Drainboard grooves are difficult or not recommended on quartz/porcelain (hard to restore polish in the machined area) — confirm material compatibility before quoting.
Seams: Pick a type, click one spot on the drawing — a full seam auto-extends edge-to-edge through that point. Drag instead for a custom length. Drag a placed seam to move it.

🏆 Associations, Groups & Industry Organizations
🪑
Rockheads Group USA
Elite Fabricator Network
Council of best-in-class stone fabricator executives. MIA accreditation required. Benchmarking, best practices, financial transparency, quarterly in-person retreats. Founded in Cleveland, OH.
🏠
Natural Stone Institute (NSI)
Trade Association
Leading association for the natural stone industry. Accreditation, education, silica safety resources, NSI certification, Building Stone Magazine, CEU programs, Stone Summits.
🏛️

Trade Association
Founded 1997. Represents fabricators of all surface types worldwide. Education, standards, advocacy, community. Recently partnered with UK’s Worktop Fabricators Federation.
🏭

Remodeling Industry
The remodeling industry’s professional association. Certified Remodeler (CR) credentials, contractor referrals, consumer protection, local chapters nationwide.
🛡️

Consumer Trust

UK & International
2,000+ surface fabrication businesses in the UK. Professionalism, best practices, silica safety advocacy. Strategic ISFA partner since 2024.

Homebuilding
140,000+ member companies. Housing market intelligence, builder confidence index, policy advocacy. Critical demand signal for countertop shops.
👥

Active fabricator community and peer group. Annual highlights, discussions across markets, open sharing of techniques and business practices.

OSHA — Silica Standard
Safety & Compliance
OSHA’s crystalline silica standard for construction and general industry. PEL of 50 μg/m³. Engineering controls, exposure assessment, medical surveillance requirements.
🌍

Global Alliance
Founded 2025 at Marmomac. Six founding countries: USA, Brazil, Italy, Greece, UK, Portugal. Global sustainability promotion for natural stone. EPD reporting framework.
🏠
NKBA — National Kitchen & Bath Association
K&B Industry
50,000+ members. Design, product, and installation standards for kitchens and baths. Key channel for countertop fabricators targeting high-end residential.

⚠️ OSHA Silica Safety — Critical Compliance Zone

Permissible Exposure Limit
50 μg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA. Action Level: 25 μg/m³. Stone fabrication is one of the highest-risk silica exposure environments.
Required Engineering Controls
Wet cutting, local exhaust ventilation, enclosed cabs on equipment, HEPA vacuums. Dry cutting prohibited without controls.
Medical Surveillance
Required if exposed at or above Action Level for 30+ days/year. Baseline chest X-ray, follow-up every 3 years.
Engineered Stone Alert
Engineered/quartz stone contains up to 95% silica. Highest risk material in the shop. Cal/OSHA and federal OSHA have enhanced enforcement focus.
OSHA Official Resources →
🏆 Certifications & Professional Standards
🏆 NSI Accreditation (MIA+BSI)
The industry’s most rigorous fabricator certification. Voluntary OSHA inspection, quality standards review, customer service evaluation. Required for Rockheads membership. Highest credential in US stone fabrication.
🏆 ISFA Fabricator Certification
ISFA’s professional certification for surface fabricators. Covers technical skills, business practices, and safety standards across all surface types.
🏆 NARI Certified Remodeler (CR)
Professional credential for remodeling contractors. Demonstrates knowledge, experience, and commitment to the industry. Consumer-facing trust signal.
⚠️ OSHA 10 & OSHA 30
Construction safety training cards. OSHA 10 for workers, OSHA 30 for supervisors. Increasingly required by GCs and builders before crews enter job sites.
🏆 NSI Natural Stone University
Online education portal with webinars, seminars, toolbox talks, and safety courses. CEU transcripts and certificates provided. AIA, ASLA, GBCI continuing education.
🏆 BBB Accreditation
Better Business Bureau accreditation. Consumer-facing trust signal for residential stone shops. Commitment to resolving complaints and ethical business practices.
